Find the right setup for your team.

OrgVia pricing is agreed with each organization. There are no public plans to compare yet.

How the conversation works

We do not list prices on this site, because the right setup depends on how many people you have and which modules you want enabled. OrgVia switches modules on per organization, so you can begin with the people record and add workflows later.

What shapes the quote

  • Number of employees
  • Modules you want enabled (for example attendance, leave, payroll, hiring)
  • Onboarding help such as importing existing employee data

What happens next

Send a request. We reply to your work email, understand your needs and give you commercial terms in writing.
